entries.name: building_blocks.block.ablock
entries.description: Get an attached block. Returns a block attached to the face of the original block. If the face is external a null pointer(0) is returned. The face must belong to the original block.

entries.name: building_blocks.block.center
entries.description: Get the center point of a block. The center point returned is the arithmetic average of block point coordinates.

entries.name: building_blocks.block.center.x
entries.description: Get the x-component of the center point of a block. The center point returned is the arithmetic average of block point coordinates.

entries.name: building_blocks.block.center.y
entries.description: Get the y-component of the center point of a block. The center point returned is the arithmetic average of block point coordinates.

entries.name: building_blocks.block.center.z
entries.description: Get the z-component of the center point of a block. The center point returned is the arithmetic average of block point coordinates.

entries.name: building_blocks.block.check
entries.description: Get the validity of a block. Possible return values are: 0 = invalid block, 1 = valid block.

entries.name: building_blocks.block.edge
entries.description: Get a block edge. Edge indices start with 1. The index must not be more than the number of edges for a block (6 = tetrahedron, 9 = wedge, 12 = hexahedron).

entries.name: building_blocks.block.extra
entries.description: Get/set the value stored in the extra variable of the building-blocks block at index i.

entries.name: building_blocks.block.face
entries.description: Get a block face. Face indices start at 1. The index cannot be more than the total number of faces for a block (4 = tetrahedron, 5 = wedge, 6 = hexahedron).

entries.name: building_blocks.block.find
entries.description: Get the building-blocks block with ID number i in set sp. Returns null if there is no such building-blocks block.

entries.name: building_blocks.block.group
entries.description: Get/set the group name assigned to block bp in slot slot, if provided. The slot named 'Default' is used by default if slot is not provided.

entries.name: building_blocks.block.group.remove
entries.description: Remove the group s from the block in any slot. The removal of s will only occur in slot, if provided.

entries.name: building_blocks.block.id
entries.description: Get the building-blocks block ID number.

entries.name: building_blocks.block.isgroup
entries.description: Check if the group s is associated with the block and return true if a match is found in any slot. The check for s will only occur in slot, if provided.

entries.name: building_blocks.block.multiplier
entries.description: Get the block multiplier.

entries.name: building_blocks.block.point
entries.description: Get a block point. Point indices start at 1. The index must not be more than the number of points for a block (4 = tetrahedron, 6 = wedge, 8 = hexahedron).

entries.name: building_blocks.block.size
entries.description: Get the number of block faces. The return values are: 4 = tetrahedron, 5 = wedge, and 6 = hexahedron.

entries.name: building_blocks.block.typeid
entries.description: Get an identifier that uniquely determines the type of object. It can be used with type.pointer.id to tell building-blocks block pointers from any other type of FISH pointer.

entries.name: building_blocks.edge.center
entries.description: Get the center point of an edge.

entries.name: building_blocks.edge.center.x
entries.description: Get the x-component of the center point of an edge.

entries.name: building_blocks.edge.center.y
entries.description: Get the y-component of the center point of an edge.

entries.name: building_blocks.edge.center.z
entries.description: Get the z-component of the center point of an edge.

entries.name: building_blocks.edge.cp.add
entries.description: Add a control point to an edge. The point is added to the edge at the position v, which must be on the edge.

entries.name: building_blocks.edge.cp.delete
entries.description: Delete a control point on an edge. The control point index must be in the range 1 to building_blocks.edge.cp.size.

entries.name: building_blocks.edge.cp.localu
entries.description: Get a local edge coordinate of a control point. The return value is 1D, a float number from 0.0 to 1.0. The control point index must be in the range 1 to building_blocks.edge.cp.size.

entries.name: building_blocks.edge.cp.point
entries.description: Get the 3D coordinates of a control point. The control point index must be in the range 1 to building_blocks.edge.cp.size.

entries.name: building_blocks.edge.cp.point.x
entries.description: Get the x-component of the the 3D coordinates of a control point. The control point index must be in the range 1 to building_blocks.edge.cp.size.

entries.name: building_blocks.edge.cp.point.y
entries.description: Get the y-component of the the 3D coordinates of a control point. The control point index must be in the range 1 to building_blocks.edge.cp.size.

entries.name: building_blocks.edge.cp.point.z
entries.description: Get the z-component of the the 3D coordinates of a control point. The control point index must be in the range 1 to building_blocks.edge.cp.size.

entries.name: building_blocks.edge.cp.size
entries.description: Get the number of control points on an edge.

entries.name: building_blocks.edge.curve
entries.description: Get edge curvature. Possible return values are: 0 = not curved (line edge), 1 = curved.

entries.name: building_blocks.edge.direction
entries.description: Get edge direction. The return value is a 3D vector from start point to the end point of the edge.

entries.name: building_blocks.edge.direction.x
entries.description: Get the x-component of edge direction. The return value is a 3D vector from start point to the end point of the edge.

entries.name: building_blocks.edge.direction.y
entries.description: Get the y-component of edge direction. The return value is a 3D vector from start point to the end point of the edge.

entries.name: building_blocks.edge.direction.z
entries.description: Get the z-component of edge direction. The return value is a 3D vector from start point to the end point of the edge.

entries.name: building_blocks.edge.extra
entries.description: Get/set the value stored in the extra variable of the building-blocks edge at index i.

entries.name: building_blocks.edge.find
entries.description: Get the building-blocks edge with ID number i in set sp. Returns null if there is no such building-blocks edge.

entries.name: building_blocks.edge.grid.ratio
entries.description: Get the ratio parameter of an edge. See the command building-blocks edge ratio.

entries.name: building_blocks.edge.grid.ratio.isolate
entries.description: Get the state of the ratio-isolate flag. See the command building-blocks edge ratio-isolate. Possible return values are: 0 = false (ratios propagate), 1 = true (ratios do not propagate).

entries.name: building_blocks.edge.grid.size
entries.description: Get the number of zones along an edge.

entries.name: building_blocks.edge.group
entries.description: Get/set the group name assigned to edge ep in slot slot, if provided. The slot named 'Default' is used by default if slot is not provided.

entries.name: building_blocks.edge.group.remove
entries.description: Remove the group s from the edge in any slot. The removal of s will only occur in slot, if provided.

entries.name: building_blocks.edge.id
entries.description: Get the building-blocks edge ID number.

entries.name: building_blocks.edge.isgroup
entries.description: Check if the group s is associated with the building-blocks edge and return true if a match is found in any slot. The check for s will only occur in slot, if provided.

entries.name: building_blocks.edge.length
entries.description: Get the length of an edge. The length reported is from the start point to the end point of the edge.

entries.name: building_blocks.edge.next.edge
entries.description: Get the next edge in a list. The list comprises edges connected to the point i on edge ep.

entries.name: building_blocks.edge.next.index
entries.description: Get the index of the next edge in a list. The list comprises all edges connected to the point i on edge ep.

entries.name: building_blocks.edge.point
entries.description: Get an edge point. The point index must be 1 or 2.

entries.name: building_blocks.edge.start.face
entries.description: Get the first face in a list. The list comprises all the faces connected to the edge ep.

entries.name: building_blocks.edge.start.index
entries.description: Get the index of the first face in a list. The list comprises all the faces connected to the edge ep.

entries.name: building_blocks.edge.toglobal
entries.description: Get the global coordinates of a point from local coordinates. Converts the local point coordinate on the edge (1D) to global coordinates (3D). The local edge coordinate of the point will range between 0.0 and 1.0.

entries.name: building_blocks.edge.toglobal.x
entries.description: Get the x-component of the global coordinates of a point from local coordinates. Converts the local point coordinate on the edge (1D) to global coordinates (3D). The local edge coordinate of the point will range between 0.0 and 1.0.

entries.name: building_blocks.edge.toglobal.y
entries.description: Get the y-component of the global coordinates of a point from local coordinates. Converts the local point coordinate on the edge (1D) to global coordinates (3D). The local edge coordinate of the point will range between 0.0 and 1.0.

entries.name: building_blocks.edge.toglobal.z
entries.description: Get the z-component of the global coordinates of a point from local coordinates. Converts the local point coordinate on the edge (1D) to global coordinates (3D). The local edge coordinate of the point will range between 0.0 and 1.0.

entries.name: building_blocks.edge.tolocal
entries.description: Get the local coordinate of a point from global coordinates. It assumed that the point is located on the edge. Return values of f will range between 0.0 and 1.0.

entries.name: building_blocks.edge.type
entries.description: Get edge type. Possible return values are: 0 = poly-line, 1 = arc, 2 = spline.

entries.name: building_blocks.edge.typeid
entries.description: Get an identifier that uniquely determines the type of object. It can be used with type.pointer.id to tell building-blocks edge pointers from any other type of FISH pointer.

entries.name: building_blocks.face.area
entries.description: Get the area of a face.

entries.name: building_blocks.face.center
entries.description: Get the center point of a face.

entries.name: building_blocks.face.center.x
entries.description: Get the x-component of the center point of a face.

entries.name: building_blocks.face.center.y
entries.description: Get the y-component of the center point of a face.

entries.name: building_blocks.face.center.z
entries.description: Get the z-component of the center point of a face.

entries.name: building_blocks.face.check
entries.description: Get the validity of the face. Possible return values are: 0 = invalid face, 1 = valid face.

entries.name: building_blocks.face.edge
entries.description: Get an edge of a face. Edge indices start with 1. The edge index must not be more than number of edges for a face (3 = triangle, 4 = quad).

entries.name: building_blocks.face.extra
entries.description: Get/set the value stored in the extra variable of the building-blocks face at index i.

entries.name: building_blocks.face.find
entries.description: Get the building-blocks face with ID number i in set sp. Returns null if there is no such building-blocks face.

entries.name: building_blocks.face.flip
entries.description: Get edge “flipped” status.

entries.name: building_blocks.face.gridsizei
entries.description: Get number of zones along the local “x” edge of a face. The return value takes into account an attached block zone multiplier. The block pointer must be attached to the face.

entries.name: building_blocks.face.gridsizej
entries.description: Get number of zones along the local “y” edge of a face. The return value takes into account an attached block zone multiplier. The block pointer must be attached to the face.

entries.name: building_blocks.face.group
entries.description: Get/set the group name assigned to face fp in slot slot, if provided. The slot named 'Default' is used by default if slot is not provided.

entries.name: building_blocks.face.group.remove
entries.description: Remove the group s from the face in any slot. The removal of s will only occur in slot, if provided.

entries.name: building_blocks.face.id
entries.description: Get the building-blocks face ID number.

entries.name: building_blocks.face.isgroup
entries.description: Check if the group s is associated with the face and return true if a match is found in any slot. The check for s will only occur in slot, if provided.

entries.name: building_blocks.face.next.face
entries.description: Get the next face in a list. The list comprises all faces connected to the point i on face fp.

entries.name: building_blocks.face.next.index
entries.description: Get the index of the next face in a list. The list comprises all faces connected to the point i on face fp.

entries.name: building_blocks.face.point
entries.description: Get a point of a face. Point indices start at 1. The point index must not be more than number of points for a face (3 = triangle, 4 = quad).

entries.name: building_blocks.face.size
entries.description: Get the number of face edges. Possible return values are: 3 = triangle, 4 = quad (it is the same as number of points).

entries.name: building_blocks.face.toglobal
entries.description: Get the global coordinates of a point from local coordinates. Converts local point coordinates on the face (2D vector) to global coordinates (3D vector).

entries.name: building_blocks.face.toglobal.x
entries.description: Get the x-component of the global coordinates of a point from local coordinates. Converts local point coordinates on the face (2D vector) to global

entries.name: building_blocks.face.toglobal.y
entries.description: Get the y-component of the global coordinates of a point from local coordinates. Converts local point coordinates on the face (2D vector) to global

entries.name: building_blocks.face.toglobal.z
entries.description: Get the z-component of the global coordinates of a point from local coordinates. Converts local point coordinates on the face (2D vector) to global

entries.name: building_blocks.face.tolocal
entries.description: Get the local coordinates of a point from global coordinates. It assumed that the point is located on the face.

entries.name: building_blocks.face.tolocal.x
entries.description: Get the x-component of the local coordinates of a point from global coordinates. It assumed that the point is located on the face.

entries.name: building_blocks.face.tolocal.y
entries.description: Get the y-component of the local coordinates of a point from global coordinates. It assumed that the point is located on the face.

entries.name: building_blocks.face.typeid
entries.description: Get an identifier that uniquely determines the type of object. It can be used with type.pointer.id to tell building-blocks face pointers from any other type of FISH pointer.

entries.name: building_blocks.point.blocks
entries.description: Get the list of blocks that use the point.

entries.name: building_blocks.point.edges
entries.description: Get the list of edges connected to the point.

entries.name: building_blocks.point.extra
entries.description: Get/set the value stored in the extra variable of the building-blocks point at index i.

entries.name: building_blocks.point.faces
entries.description: Get the list of faces that use the point.

entries.name: building_blocks.point.find
entries.description: Get the point with ID number i in set sp. Returns null if there is none (the live table prints the return type as edge_pnt).

entries.name: building_blocks.point.group
entries.description: Get/set the group name assigned to point pp in slot slot, if provided. The slot named 'Default' is used by default if slot is not provided.

entries.name: building_blocks.point.group.remove
entries.description: Remove the group s from the point in any slot. The removal of s will only occur in slot, if provided.

entries.name: building_blocks.point.id
entries.description: Get the building-blocks point ID number.

entries.name: building_blocks.point.isgroup
entries.description: Check if the group s is associated with the point and return true if a match is found in any slot. The check for s will only occur in slot, if provided.

entries.name: building_blocks.point.pos
entries.description: Get point position. Returns global (3D) coordinates.

entries.name: building_blocks.point.pos.x
entries.description: Get the x-component of point position. Returns global (3D) coordinates.

entries.name: building_blocks.point.pos.y
entries.description: Get the y-component of point position. Returns global (3D) coordinates.

entries.name: building_blocks.point.pos.z
entries.description: Get the z-component of point position. Returns global (3D) coordinates.

entries.name: building_blocks.point.start.edge
entries.description: Get the first edge in a list. The list comprises edges connected to the point p.

entries.name: building_blocks.point.start.index
entries.description: Get the index of this point on the first edge in the list of edges connected to this point.

entries.name: building_blocks.point.typeid
entries.description: Get an identifier that uniquely determines the type of object. It can be used with type.pointer.id to tell building-blocks point pointers from any other type of FISH pointer.

entries.name: building_blocks.set.arrest
entries.description: Arrest the set (the 'building-blocks set arrest' action, stopping its block movement); returns true on success. Undocumented in the 9.8 manual.

entries.name: building_blocks.set.block.create
entries.description: Create a block. Returns null (0) on failure. Strings that may be supplied for s are “hexahedron”, “wedge” or “tetrahedron”. Supply eight (hexahedron), six (wedge), or four (tetrahedron) point coordinates (vn) as needed.

entries.name: building_blocks.set.block.delete
entries.description: Delete block bp from the set.

entries.name: building_blocks.set.block.find
entries.description: Get a block by ID. Null pointer (0) is returned if unsuccessful.

entries.name: building_blocks.set.block.list
entries.description: Get a block container from a set. The list of blocks from building blocks set sp is returned.

entries.name: building_blocks.set.block.size
entries.description: Get the number of blocks in a set.

entries.name: building_blocks.set.create
entries.description: Create a building blocks set. The set is given the name s and the ID i. Returns null (0) if unsuccessful.

entries.name: building_blocks.set.delete
entries.description: Delete a building blocks set. Returns a pointer to the next set in the container of building blocks sets or 0 if unsuccessful.

entries.name: building_blocks.set.dihedralcut
entries.description: Get/set the dihedral cut angle of the set. Undocumented in the 9.8 manual.

entries.name: building_blocks.set.edge.find
entries.description: Get an edge by ID. Returns a null pointer (0) if unsuccessful.

entries.name: building_blocks.set.edge.list
entries.description: Get an edge container from a set. The list of edges from building blocks set sp is returned.

entries.name: building_blocks.set.edge.near
entries.description: Get the nearest edge from coordinates.

entries.name: building_blocks.set.edge.size
entries.description: Get the number of edges. The number of edges from building blocks set sp is returned.

entries.name: building_blocks.set.face.find
entries.description: Get face by ID. Returns null pointer (0) if unsuccessful.

entries.name: building_blocks.set.face.list
entries.description: Get a face container from a set. The list of faces from building blocks set sp is returned.

entries.name: building_blocks.set.face.near
entries.description: Get the nearest face from coordinates.

entries.name: building_blocks.set.face.size
entries.description: Get the number of faces in a set.

entries.name: building_blocks.set.find
entries.description: Get a set by the name or by ID. Returns null (0) if unsuccessful.

entries.name: building_blocks.set.id
entries.description: Get the building blocks set ID.

entries.name: building_blocks.set.list
entries.description: Get a container of building blocks sets.

entries.name: building_blocks.set.name
entries.description: Get the name of the building blocks set.

entries.name: building_blocks.set.point.find
entries.description: Get a point by ID. Returns null pointer (0) if unsuccessful.

entries.name: building_blocks.set.point.list
entries.description: Get a point container from a set. The list of points from building blocks set sp is returned.

entries.name: building_blocks.set.point.near
entries.description: Get the nearest point from coordinates.

entries.name: building_blocks.set.point.size
entries.description: Get the number of points in a set.
